verdict.rationale: Reducto Studio lets users build document workflows and deploy them as a callable Pipeline ID, so versioning automations is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents version history, review or approval of changes, or rolling back to an earlier pipeline version. Deploying a pipeline is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
